OD1.source_version: NSE Indices Industry Classification Structure — November 2022
conditions: Use the frozen November-2022 taxonomy to organize strictly point-in-time company evidence.
Do not introduce future company attributes.
Every synonym must map to an official taxonomy node with evidence.
Broad, conflicting or ambiguous descriptions remain blocked.
Every mapping-catalog change requires a new version and deterministic rerun.
Audited consolidated annual evidence only under V1.
Same-period accounting reconciliation and comparable segment external revenue required.
Strict greater-than-50-percent dominance; exactly 50 percent fails.
No denominator substitution or combining distinct segments to manufacture dominance.
Do not design or adopt a new diversified-company methodology.
No specialised methodology route for diversified cases.

measured_implication.note: Policy adoption does not change the frozen canary measurement and does not make the expansion gate pass.

exact_owner_approval_statement: I approve OD1 under the frozen NSE November-2022 taxonomy reference, OD2 with versioned evidence-backed review control, and OD3 under `P8_HISTORICAL_SEGMENT_REVENUE_CLASSIFICATION_CANDIDATE_V1` frozen at Git blob `45e990981371dba217d12c430f8ce567acbf25fc`. OD4 remains blocked. This approval adopts the policy contracts only; it does not authorize 25,761-pair expansion, experiment freeze/execution, B5/B6/B-FINAL rebuild, or P8-C.
